question: How much does Truplexy cost?
answer: Starter is $29 a month and Pro is $79 a month, or less when billed yearly ($23 and $63 a month). Both start with a 7-day free trial. Enterprise is priced to your volume: contact sales at https://truplexy.com/demo?topic=sales. Prices are in US dollars, excluding any sales tax or VAT.

question: Is there a free plan?
answer: No. The Free plan was retired. New accounts start with a 7-day free trial of Starter or Pro, which needs a payment method but charges nothing during the trial.

question: How does the free trial work?
answer: Starter and Pro start with a 7-day free trial. You add a payment method to start it and nothing is charged during the trial. When it ends, your payment method is charged for the plan you chose. Cancel before it ends and you pay nothing. The trial is limited to one per customer.

question: Can I cancel at any time?
answer: Yes. A paid plan can be cancelled any time in the dashboard or by emailing hello@truplexy.com. Cancelling stops the next renewal and you keep access until the end of the period you paid for.

question: Do you offer refunds?
answer: Yes. Your first payment on a paid plan is refundable in full within 14 days, once per customer. Renewals, used tokens and payments after the 14 days are not refundable. Email hello@truplexy.com to ask.

question: How much is yearly billing?
answer: Yearly billing saves 20%. Starter is $23 a month ($276 a year) and Pro is $63 a month ($756 a year).

question: What does Starter include?
answer: Starter ($29 a month) includes about 10,000 est. AI replies and 10M tokens a month, 3 bots, 300 knowledge documents per bot, 10 team members, all messaging channels, Shopify, WooCommerce and WordPress, a unified inbox, custom tools, human handoff, and a limited REST API with email support.

question: What does Pro include?
answer: Pro ($79 a month) includes everything in Starter plus about 50,000 est. AI replies and 50M tokens a month, 10 bots, 1,000 documents per bot, 25 team members, the full REST API, webhooks, web search as listed on the pricing page, and priority support.

question: What does Enterprise include?
answer: Enterprise is priced on request. It includes unlimited replies and tokens, up to 100 bots, 500 team members, custom limits, hands-on onboarding and dedicated support. Contact sales at https://truplexy.com/demo?topic=sales.

question: What happens when my tokens run out?
answer: Further replies are paid from your account balance. If the balance reaches zero, the assistant stops replying until you add funds or the next month starts. You can also buy token add-ons: $8 per 1M on Starter (up to +5M a month) and $6 per 1M on Pro (up to +30M a month).

question: Which channels does Truplexy work on?
answer: Website chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Discord and Email, plus Shopify, WooCommerce and WordPress, and a REST API, webhooks and custom integrations. HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack and Microsoft Teams are coming soon.

question: Does Truplexy work with HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack or Microsoft Teams?
answer: Not yet. These four integrations are coming soon and cannot be connected today.

question: How do I connect WhatsApp?
answer: Through your own Meta app, from Integrations in the dashboard. You need the Phone number ID, the WhatsApp Business Account ID, a system-user access token and the app secret. A step-by-step guide in the dashboard walks you through it.

question: Is there a time limit for replying on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram?
answer: Yes. Your team cannot write to a customer more than 24 hours after their last message on these Meta channels, and Truplexy does not send template messages.

question: Does it work with a personal Instagram account?
answer: No. Instagram only offers messaging to professional accounts connected to a Facebook Page.

question: How do I add the chat to my website?
answer: Add the widget and one route on your server that holds your chat key, or on WordPress install the Truplexy Chat plugin and paste the key. Guide: https://truplexy.com/docs/web-sdk.

question: Does the chat widget use cookies?
answer: No. The widget sets no cookies. It keeps a signed session token and the visitor's details in local storage.

question: Can customers send pictures in the chat?
answer: Not yet. Picture input is not available.

question: How does the assistant know my business?
answer: It answers from the knowledge you add: articles you write and files you upload (Markdown, text, CSV, JSON, HTML, PDF and Word). It can show customers its sources, and says so when it can't find a reliable answer.

question: How accurate are the AI answers?
answer: The assistant answers from your knowledge and can show sources. When it can't find a reliable answer it says so, asks a clarifying question or offers a person. AI replies can still be wrong, so your team can read and correct any conversation.

question: What happens when a customer needs a person?
answer: The assistant hands the conversation to your team with the full history. A teammate takes over in one click and the customer keeps talking on the same channel.

question: Can tickets be assigned to my team automatically?
answer: Yes. Auto-assign gives tickets round-robin to available team members by support role (category), overall, or not at all.

question: What do you do with our data and our customers' data?
answer: Truplexy processes conversations on your behalf and sends only the relevant conversation part and knowledge passages to the AI model provider. Zenova Agency does not train AI models on your content or your customers' conversations and does not sell personal data. Connections use HTTPS and platform tokens are stored encrypted.

question: How long is conversation history kept?
answer: 90 days on Starter, 1 year on Pro, and 7 days while a business has no plan.

question: Do I need a developer?
answer: No for the dashboard, Discord, Shopify and WordPress. A developer is needed for the website chat route, Telegram, Email, the REST API, webhooks and custom tools.

question: Is there a REST API?
answer: Yes. Starter has a limited REST API, Pro and Enterprise have the full one. Webhooks are on Pro and Enterprise.

question: Who makes Truplexy?
answer: Truplexy is built and run by Zenova Agency in Gazipur, Bangladesh. It is an independent product and is not Perplexity AI.

question: How do I contact Truplexy or talk to sales?
answer: Email hello@truplexy.com or book a demo at https://truplexy.com/demo.

question: Where do I sign up?
answer: Create an account at https://app.truplexy.com, or pick a plan at https://truplexy.com/pricing.
